-- BedManager Module
-- Handles bed references, health tracking, and destruction notifications

local BedManager = {}

-- Table to store bed parts by team color
local beds = {}

-- RemoteEvent used to broadcast bed destruction
local bedwarsComm = game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.RemoteEvent

-- Initialize the manager; call once at game start
function BedManager:Initialize()
    -- Placeholder: beds will be filled by MapBuilder when it creates the map
    beds = {}
end

-- Register a bed for a specific team color
function BedManager:RegisterBed(teamColor, bedPart)
    beds[teamColor] = bedPart
end

-- Retrieve the bed part for a team (if any)
function BedManager:GetBed(teamColor)
    return beds[teamColor]
end

-- Track damage to a bed; `damage` is an optional value (e.g., 1 for normal hit)
function BedManager:ApplyDamage(teamColor, damage)
    local bed = beds[teamColor]
    if not bed then return end

    -- Simple health system: assume bed is destroyed on any damage for now
    -- Future improvement: track health value
    self:DestroyBed(teamColor)
end

-- Destroy a bed and notify all players
function BedManager:DestroyBed(teamColor)
    local bed = beds[teamColor]
    if not bed then return end

    -- Change bed appearance to indicate destruction
    bed.Transparency = 0.5
    bed.CanCollide = false

    -- Notify all clients via RemoteEvent
    bedwarsComm:FireAllClients("BedDestroyed", teamColor)

    -- Clean up reference
    beds[teamColor] = nil
end

-- Utility: check if a team still has an active bed
function BedManager:HasActiveBed(teamColor)
    return beds[teamColor] ~= nil
end

return BedManager

-- Handles resource generation (Iron, Gold, Emerald), player collection, and resource tracking

local ResourceManager = {}

    if typeof(resourceType) == "string" and resources[resourceType] ~= nil then
        resources[resourceType] = resources[resourceType] + amount
        -- Broadcast the updated amounts to all clients
        bedwarsComm:FireAllClients("ResourceUpdate", {

            Gold = resources.Gold,
            Emerald = resources.Emerald,

    -- Optionally start any periodic generation here or let MapBuilder handle it

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- PURCHASE PROCESSING
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Processes a purchase request from a player.
-- Returns true on success, false on failure, and an error message.
-- All resource deductions are performed through ResourceManager.
-- Items are granted directly to the player's Backpack.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
function ShopSystem:ProcessPurchase(player, itemId)
	-- Validate item existence
	local itemInfo = ITEM_CATALOG[itemId]
	if not itemInfo then
		return false, "Invalid item ID."
	end

	-- Determine which team the player belongs to
	local TeamManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.TeamManager)
	local teamColor = nil
	for color, data in pairs(TeamManager:GetAllTeamColors()) do
		for _, p in ipairs(data.players) do
			if p == player then
				teamColor = color
				break
			end
		end
		if teamColor then break end
	end
	if not teamColor then
		return false, "Player not assigned to a team."
	end

	-- Get the ResourceManager to check and modify resources
	local ResourceManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.ResourceManager)
	local required = itemInfo.Price
	if itemInfo.Resource == "Iron" or itemInfo.Resource == "Gold" or itemInfo.Resource == "Emerald" then
		if ResourceManager:GetResourceAmount(itemInfo.Resource) < required then
			return false, "Insufficient " .. itemInfo.Resource .. "."
		end
	else
		return false, "Unknown resource type."
	end

	-- Deduct the required resource
	ResourceManager:AddResource(itemInfo.Resource, -required)

	-- Grant the purchased item to the player
	-- Simple implementation: give a Tool named after the item
	local purchased = Instance.new("Tool")
	purchased.Name = itemInfo.Name
	purchased.Parent = player.Backpack

	-- Optional: tag tools with a value for later identification
	purchased:SetAttribute("ItemId", itemId)

	-- Notify the player that the purchase succeeded
	BEDWARS_COMM:FireClient(player, "PurchaseSuccess", itemInfo.Name)
	return true, "Purchase successful."
end

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------

end

local function createPart(params)
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = params.Size or Vector3.new(10, 10, 10)
    part.Position = params.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = true
    part.BrickColor = params.BrickColor or BrickColor.new("Medium stone grey")
    if params.Name then
        part.Name = params.Name
    end
    if params.Color3 then
        part.Color = params.Color3
    end
    part.Parent = workspace
    return part
end

-- Build the central resource island
function MapBuilder:BuildCentralIsland()
    local island = createPart{
        Size = Vector3.new(80, 5, 80),
        Position = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0),
        Name = "CentralIsland",
        BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright stone grey"),
    }

    -- Iron spawn location
    createPart{
        Size = Vector3.new(8, 3, 8),
        Position = Vector3.new(15, 5, 0),
        Name = "IronSpawn",
        Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 0),
    }

    -- Gold spawn location
    createPart{
        Size = Vector3.new(8, 3, 8),
        Position = Vector3.new(-15, 5, 0),
        Name = "GoldSpawn",
        Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 0),
    }

    -- Emerald spawn location
    createPart{
        Size = Vector3.new(8, 3, 8),
        Position = Vector3.new(0, 5, 15),
        Name = "EmeraldSpawn",
        Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 0),
    }
end

-- Build team-specific islands with beds and generators
function MapBuilder:BuildTeamIslands()
    local teamPositions = {
        Red = Vector3.new(-80, 5, 0),
        Blue = Vector3.new(80, 5, 0),
        Green = Vector3.new(0, 5, -80),
        Yellow = Vector3.new(0, 5, 80),
    }

    for color, pos in pairs(teamPositions) do
        -- Island base
        local island = createPart{
            Size = Vector3.new(60, 5, 60),
            Position = pos,
            Name = color .. "Island",
            BrickColor = BrickColor.new(
                ({Red="Bright red", Blue="Bright blue", Green="Bright green", Yellow="Bright yellow"})[color]
            ),
        }

        -- Bed part
        local bed = createPart{
            Size = Vector3.new(12, 3, 12),
            Position = pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
            Name = "Bed",
            BrickColor = BrickColor.new(
                ({Red="Bright red", Blue="Bright blue", Green="Bright green", Yellow="Bright yellow"})[color]
            ),
        }
        -- Register this bed with the BedManager
        local bedManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.BedManager)
        bedManager:RegisterBed(color:lower(), bed)

        -- Iron generator (simple block)
        createPart{
            Size = Vector3.new(6, 5, 6),
            Position = pos + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
            Name = "IronGenerator",
            BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright orange"),
            Parent = island,
        }

        -- Gold generator (simple block)
        createPart{
            Size = Vector3.new(6, 5, 6),
            Position = pos + Vector3.new(10, 2, 0),
            Name = "GoldGenerator",
            BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow"),
            Parent = island,
        }
    end
end

-- Public method to construct the full map
function MapBuilder:BuildMap()
    self:BuildCentralIsland()
    self:BuildTeamIslands()
end

return MapBuilder

    self:DestroyBed(teamColor)

    -- Clean up reference
    beds[teamColor] = nil
end

-- All resource deductions are performed through ResourceManager.
-- Items are granted directly to the player's Backpack.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
function ShopSystem:ProcessPurchase(player, itemId)
	-- Validate item existence
	local itemInfo = ITEM_CATALOG[itemId]
	if not itemInfo then
		return false, "Invalid item ID."
	end

	-- Determine which team the player belongs to
	local TeamManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.TeamManager)
	local teamColor = nil
	for color, data in pairs(TeamManager:GetAllTeamColors()) do
		for _, p in ipairs(data.players) do
			if p == player then
				teamColor = color
				break
			end
		end
		if teamColor then break end
	end
	if not teamColor then
		return false, "Player not assigned to a team."
	end

	-- Get the ResourceManager to check and modify resources
	local ResourceManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.ResourceManager)
	local required = itemInfo.Price
	if itemInfo.Resource == "Iron" or itemInfo.Resource == "Gold" or itemInfo.Resource == "Emerald" then
		if ResourceManager:GetResourceAmount(itemInfo.Resource) < required then
			return false, "Insufficient " .. itemInfo.Resource .. "."
		end
	else
		return false, "Unknown resource type."
	end

	-- Deduct the required resource
	ResourceManager:AddResource(itemInfo.Resource, -required)

	-- Grant the purchased item to the player
	-- Simple implementation: give a Tool named after the item
	local purchased = Instance.new("Tool")
	purchased.Name = itemInfo.Name
	purchased.Parent = player.Backpack

	-- Optional: tag tools with a value for later identification
	purchased:SetAttribute("ItemId", itemId)

	-- Notify the player that the purchase succeeded
	BEDWARS_COMM:FireClient(player, "PurchaseSuccess", itemInfo.Name)
	return true, "Purchase successful."
end

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------

function ShopSystem:GetItemInfo(itemId)
	return ITEM_CATALOG[itemId]
end

local scoreLabel = gui.ScoreFrame.ScoreLabel
local shopFrame = gui.ShopFrame
local shopTemplate = shopFrame:FindFirstChild("ShopItemTemplate")

-- Will store the local player's assigned team

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helper: create a shop item button from the template part
local function createShopItem(itemInfo)
    if not shopTemplate then return end
    local button = shopTemplate:Clone()
    button.Visible = true
    button.Name = "Item_" .. itemInfo.Name

    -- Fill in UI text fields (adjust to match your UI design)

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Remote:FireServer("PurchaseRequest", itemInfo.Id)  -- assuming you store Id in catalog
    end)

    button.Parent = shopFrame

        -- Update UI (e.g., show team color icon) if desired

	},

-- All resource deductions are performed through ResourceManager.
-- Items are granted directly to the player's Backpack.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
function ShopSystem:ProcessPurchase(player, itemId)
	-- Validate item existence
	local itemInfo = ITEM_CATALOG[itemId]
	if not itemInfo then
		return false, "Invalid item ID."
	end

	-- Determine which team the player belongs to
	local TeamManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.TeamManager)
	local teamColor = nil
	for color, data in pairs(TeamManager:GetAllTeamColors()) do
		for _, p in ipairs(data.players) do
			if p == player then
				teamColor = color
				break
			end
		end
		if teamColor then break end
	end
	if not teamColor then
		return false, "Player not assigned to a team."
	end

	-- Get the ResourceManager to check and modify resources
	local ResourceManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.ResourceManager)
	local required = itemInfo.Price
	if itemInfo.Resource == "Iron" or itemInfo.Resource == "Gold" or itemInfo.Resource == "Emerald" then
		if ResourceManager:GetResourceAmount(itemInfo.Resource) < required then
			return false, "Insufficient " .. itemInfo.Resource .. "."
		end
	else
		return false, "Unknown resource type."
	end

	-- Deduct the required resource
	ResourceManager:AddResource(itemInfo.Resource, -required)

	-- Grant the purchased item to the player
	-- Simple implementation: give a Tool named after the item
	local purchased = Instance.new("Tool")
	purchased.Name = itemInfo.Name
	purchased.Parent = player.Backpack

	-- Optional: tag tools with a value for later identification
	purchased:SetAttribute("ItemId", itemId)

	-- Notify the player that the purchase succeeded
	BEDWARS_COMM:FireClient(player, "PurchaseSuccess", itemInfo.Name)
	return true, "Purchase successful."
end

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- ITEM LOOKUP HELPER
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Returns a formatted string for UI display of an item's details.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
function ShopSystem:GetItemInfo(itemId)
	return ITEM_CATALOG[itemId]
end

return ShopSystem

-- BedDestroyHandler – detects when an enemy touches a bed and destroys it

local BedDestroyHandler = {}

local BedManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.BedManager)
local TeamManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.TeamManager)

-- When any part touches a registered bed, check if the toucher belongs to a different team.
local function onBedTouched(bedPart, otherPart)
    local character = otherPart.Parent
    if not character then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    if not player then return end

    -- Identify which team the bed belongs to (the bed's Name attribute stores the team color)
    local bedTeam = bedPart.Name:match("^(.+?)Bed$") or ""
    if not bedTeam or bedTeam == "" then return end

    local playerTeam = nil
    for color, data in pairs(TeamManager:GetAllTeamColors()) do
        for _, p in ipairs(data.players) do
            if p == player then
                playerTeam = color
                break
            end
        end
        if playerTeam then break end
    end
    if not playerTeam then return end

    -- If the touching player is NOT on the same team as the bed, destroy that bed
    if playerTeam ~= bedTeam then
        BedManager:DestroyBed(bedTeam)
    end
end

-- Connect the listener to every bed that currently exists
for _, bedPart in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if bedPart.Name ~= "Bed" then continue end
    -- The BedManager registers each bed with its team color; we can reuse that mapping
    local bedTeam = bedPart.Name:match("^(.+?)Bed$") or ""
    if bedTeam ~= "" then
        bedPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit) onBedTouched(bedPart, hit) end)
    end
end

-- Also hook newly created beds by monitoring BedManager registration
local function hookNewBed(teamColor, bedPart)
    bedPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit) onBedTouched(bedPart, hit) end)
end

-- Since BedManager:RegisterBed is the only place beds are added,
-- we can override it temporarily (the module does not expose a replaceable function,
-- so we simply connect once at startup)
local originalRegister = BedManager.RegisterBed
function BedManager:RegisterBed(teamColor, bedPart)
    originalRegister(self, teamColor, bedPart)
    hookNewBed(teamColor, bedPart)
end

return BedDestroyHandler

-- ResourceSpawner – periodically creates Iron, Gold, and Emerald pickup parts
-- that players can touch to collect resources.

local ResourceSpawner = {}

local ResourceManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.ResourceManager)
local BEDWARS_COMM = game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.RemoteEvent

local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5  -- seconds between spawns
local SPAWN_POINTS = {
    -- Iron spawn point
    {type = "Iron",    pos = Vector3.new(15,5,0)},
    {type = "Gold",    pos = Vector3.new(-15,5,0)},
    {type = "Emerald", pos = Vector3.new(0,5,15)},
}

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Creates a pickup part for the given resource type at the given position.
local function createPickup(resourceType, position)
    local pickup = Instance.new("Part")
    pickup.Size = Vector3.new(4,2,4)
    pickup.Position = position
    pickup.Anchored = true
    pickup.CanCollide = true
    pickup.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright violet")
    pickup.Name = resourceType .. "Pickup"
    pickup.Parent = workspace

    -- Auto‑destroy after 30 seconds to keep the world tidy
    spawn(function()
        wait(30)
        if pickup and pickup.Parent then pickup:Destroy() end
    end)

    -- When a player touches the pickup, grant the appropriate resource
    pickup.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local character = hit.Parent
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then return end
        local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
        if not player then return end

        if resourceType == "Iron" then
            ResourceManager:AddResource("Iron", 1)
        elseif resourceType == "Gold" then
            ResourceManager:AddResource("Gold", 1)
        elseif resourceType == "Emerald" then
            ResourceManager:AddResource("Emerald", 1)
        end

        pickup:Destroy()
    end)
end

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Main loop: spawns resources at each defined point, then waits before repeating.
function ResourceSpawner:Start()
    while true do
        for _, point in ipairs(SPAWN_POINTS) do
            createPickup(point.type, point.pos)
        end
        wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
    end
end

return ResourceSpawner

local Remote          = game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.RemoteEvent

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Total match duration (seconds) before forcing a winner
local MATCH_DURATION = 120

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Build the map, start spawning resources, and start the match timer
local function startMatch()
    -- 1️⃣ Build the floating islands, beds, generators
    MapBuilder:BuildMap()

    -- 2️⃣ Begin periodic resource pickup spawning
    local spawner = ResourceSpawner
    spawner:Start()

    -- 3️⃣ Initialize team data (ensures scores/tables exist)
    TeamManager:Initialize()

    -- 4️⃣ Track active beds and enforce win conditions
    while true do
        wait(1)  -- iterate once per second

        -- Count how many beds are still alive
        local aliveCount = 0
        local survivingTeam = nil
        for _, color in ipairs({"Red", "Blue", "Green", "Yellow"}) do
            if BedManager:HasActiveBed(color) then
                aliveCount = aliveCount + 1
                survivingTeam = color
            end
        end

        -- If only one (or zero) team has a bed left, game over
        if aliveCount <= 1 then
            local winner = survivingTeam or "Neutral"
            Remote:FireAllClients("MatchEnded", winner)
            wait(10)  -- brief pause before resetting / ending
            break
        end

        -- Enforce the time limit
        if os.time() - startTime > MATCH_DURATION then
            -- Time's up – pick the team with the most active beds
            local bestTeam = nil
            local bestCount = 0
            for _, color in ipairs({"Red", "Blue", "Green", "Yellow"}) do
                if BedManager:HasActiveBed(color) then
                    bestCount = bestCount + 1
                    bestTeam = color
                end
            end
            Remote:FireAllClients("MatchEnded", bestTeam or "Neutral")
            wait(10)
            break
        end
    end
end

    if teamColor then
        Remote:FireClient(player, "TeamAssigned", teamColor)
    end
end)

-- Kick off the match once all required modules are loaded
local startTime = os.time()
spawn(function()
    startMatch()
end)

local function createPart(params)
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = params.Size or Vector3.new(10,10,10)
    part.Position = params.Position or Vector3.new(0,0,0)
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = true
    if params.BrickColor then
        part.BrickColor = params.BrickColor
    elseif params.Color3 then
        part.Color = params.Color3
    end
    if params.Name then part.Name = params.Name end
    if params.Parent then
        part.Parent = params.Parent
    else

    return part
end

-- Handles shop items and purchase logic for BedWars

local ShopSystem = {}

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- ITEM CATALOG
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Each entry represents a purchasable item.
--   Name        : Display name shown to the player
--   Price       : Cost in the relevant resource (Iron, Gold, Emerald)
--   Type        : "Block", "Weapon", "Armor", "Tool", "Utility"
--   Resource    : The resource type used for purchase (Iron, Gold, Emerald)
--   Description : Optional long description
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
local ITEM_CATALOG = {
	-- Blocks (cost Iron)
	[1] = {
		Name = "Red Wool",
		Price = 5,
		Type = "Block",
		Resource = "Iron",
		Description = "Standard red building block."
	},
	[2] = {

	},
	[4] = {

	},
	-- Weapons (cost Emerald)
	[10] = {

	-- Armor (cost Gold)
	[20] = {

	[21] = {

		Description = "Medium armor with better damage reduction."
	},
	-- Tools (cost Iron)
	[30] = {

		Type = "Tool",
		Resource = "Iron",
		Description = "Allows faster block breaking."
	},
	[31] = {

		Price = 12,
		Type = "Tool",
		Resource = "Iron",
		Description = "Allows faster digging."
	},
	-- Utility (cost Emerald)
	[40] = {

		Price = 25,
		Type = "Utility",
		Resource = "Emerald",
		Description = "Temporary speed increase for 10 seconds."
	},
	[41] = {
		Name = "Shield",
		Price = 20,
		Type = "Utility",
		Resource = "Emerald",
		Description = "Blocks incoming damage once per use."
	},
}

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- REMOTE EVENT REFERENCE
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
local BEDWARS_COMM = game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.RemoteEvent

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- PURCHASE PROCESSING
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Processes a purchase request from a player.
-- Returns true on success, false on failure, and an error message.
-- All resource deductions are performed through ResourceManager.
-- Items are granted directly to the player's Backpack.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
function ShopSystem:ProcessPurchase(player, itemId)
	-- Validate item existence
	local itemInfo = ITEM_CATALOG[itemId]
	if not itemInfo then
		return false, "Invalid item ID."
	end

	-- Determine which team the player belongs to
	local TeamManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.TeamManager)
	local teamColor = nil
	for color, data in pairs(TeamManager:GetAllTeamColors()) do
		for _, p in ipairs(data.players) do
			if p == player then
				teamColor = color
				break
			end
		end
		if teamColor then break end
	end
	if not teamColor then
		return false, "Player not assigned to a team."
	end

	-- Get the ResourceManager to check and modify resources
	local ResourceManager = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Bedwars.ResourceManager)
	local required = itemInfo.Price
	if itemInfo.Resource == "Iron" or itemInfo.Resource == "Gold" or itemInfo.Resource == "Emerald" then
		if ResourceManager:GetResourceAmount(itemInfo.Resource) < required then
			return false, "Insufficient " .. itemInfo.Resource .. "."
		end
	else
		return false, "Unknown resource type."
	end

	-- Deduct the required resource
	ResourceManager:AddResource(itemInfo.Resource, -required)

	-- Grant the purchased item to the player
	-- Simple implementation: give a Tool named after the item
	local purchased = Instance.new("Tool")
	purchased.Name = itemInfo.Name
	purchased.Parent = player.Backpack

	-- Optional: tag tools with a value for later identification
	purchased:SetAttribute("ItemId", itemId)

	-- Notify the player that the purchase succeeded
	BEDWARS_COMM:FireClient(player, "PurchaseSuccess", itemInfo.Name)
	return true, "Purchase successful."
end

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- ITEM LOOKUP HELPER
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Returns a formatted string for UI display of an item's details.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
function ShopSystem:GetItemInfo(itemId)
	return ITEM_CATALOG[itemId]
end

return ShopSystem
